labels.caption: Lendable slack (capacity minus the high-priority jobs' occupancy, at least 0) of the six GPU pools of Alibaba's cluster-trace-v2026-spot-gpu [duan2026gfs] at 5-min slots: daily minimum to maximum (band) and daily mean (line) over 177 days from the end of the trace's first week, which the analysis drops; each y axis runs from 0 to the pool's capacity (title). The trace's last 18 slots (90 min), in which every pool's slack jumps at once to at least 82% of its capacity, are left out. Thin light line: P25, the 25th percentile of the pool's slack over the whole series (the slack reaches it in at least 75% of the slots). At its default lease-size quantile (P25) the simulator takes this quantile of the slack left after the lender's notice buffer and rounds it down to whole layers, so the top of the block a spot lender offers lies at or below this line. (a) A10: P25 = 0; its slack is zero in 94.0% of the slots, in every slot until day 166, and its daily mean is 92–126 GPUs from day 167 on.
